observations.what: The free-trial flow asked for the work email on try-it, then again on a second app.smartsheet.com signup page, and each triggered a reCAPTCHA image challenge (crosswalks, then buses).
After the second submit the signup page showed a generic 'Sorry - an error has occurred' page; reloading brought the form back with no confirmation that the account was created.
No verification email or code arrived after the final submit, and the page showed no 'check your inbox' message or resend option.
The try-it page offers only Google, Microsoft and Apple social sign-up beside the work-email field, with a visible data-region selector.
After a captcha tile click the page layout shifted, so my Verify click at stale coordinates hit 'Sign up with Microsoft' and left the signup flow; I navigated back without using it.
I spent about 16 of the 40 steps on captcha tile clicks and re-submits, leaving no budget to retry after the error page.
